'''Greater Galam''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Lan (star)|Lan]]<ref name="Journal 1" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> [[Lan system]]. It had sixteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was situated within the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]. Greater Galam and its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Journal 1" /> around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]" dates the discovery of the [[Lan system]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to around 1,300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], which equates to around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] conglomerate [[Gaminne Group, Inc.]] purchased the system's [[Miner/Legends|mining]] rights from the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the system's fourth planet, [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] the Galactic Republic had been [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Qieg and a group of Human [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] had eventually formed a stable government, the [[Human-Qieg Guild]], to oversee the entire Lan system, including Greater Galam.<ref name="Journal 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Greater Galam was first mentioned in "[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first installment]] of the [[West End Games]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The article was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and released in [[February]] [[1994]].<ref name="Journal 1" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Lan system, and therefore Greater Galam, in grid square O-18.<ref name="Atlas" />
